purpose: New prospective development diagnostic; does not rescore or replace v1 acceptance

label_challenges.selection: For each of the 12 synthetic contracts, assess its gold label and one wrong label; no Judge inference in this controlled intervention

human_review_policy: Every explanation_repair row requires a named reviewer, four boolean judgments and a note; all four must pass. The reviewer must actually inspect claim/context and rationale. Script output is not human review.
promotion: Never automatic; retain audited repair in serving until model and human evaluation support a separate promotion decision
